Row.Text: 七国+周，关中、蜀地、三峡、太行八陉。
Seven states plus Zhou, Guanzhong, Shu, Three Gorges, Taihang passes.
固定地形的战国中国地图（巨大 106x66）。黄河、渭水、长江、淮河、岷江用海岸格表示，关隘由山脉缺口构成。
Fixed-terrain Warring States China (Huge, 106x66). Major rivers are coast tiles; passes are gaps in mountain ranges.
秦、楚、齐、燕、韩、赵、魏与周。关中四塞，蜀道，三峡夷陵，太行八陉。（V3.20 · 2026-10-09）
Qin, Chu, Qi, Yan, Han, Zhao, Wei and Zhou, with the famous passes of ancient China. (V3.20, 2026-10-09)

Replace.Text: 完工后自动在两侧建造 1 到 2 个运河区，舰船可以从这一格直接穿过。穿过它的贸易路线能放大目的地各区域的金币收益。+10 金币。（规则与巴拿马运河相同，在本地图中是京杭大运河。）

On completion 1 or 2 adjacent Canal districts are built automatically and ships can cross this tile. Trade routes through it multiply the Gold from districts at their destination. +10 Gold. (Same rules as the Panama Canal; on this map it is the Grand Canal.)
